evidence.excerpt_or_description: The front view shows the copper loop geometry.
The antenna follows a Hilbert curve and contains three nested Hilbert loops with optimized interconnections.

expected.summary: Represent the three nested Hilbert-inspired loops and their interconnections as source-backed conductive paths.
expected.acceptable_alternative: Record an explicit reconstruction-blocking unresolved path when Figure 9 cannot define a segment.
expected.forbidden_condition: Replacing the Hilbert paths with a plain rectangular loop.

assertions.review_instruction: Compare path count, nesting, interconnections, and segment layout against Figure 9(a).

evidence.excerpt_or_description: Side and exploded views show the antenna's conformal relation to the capsule assembly.
The final antenna shape is acquired in the presence of the battery and modules inside the ceramic alumina capsule.

expected.summary: Place the antenna conformally around the capsule inner wall using only source-supported curvature and placement.
expected.acceptable_alternative: Create an explicit reconstruction-critical unresolved item if curvature or placement is not fully recoverable.
expected.forbidden_condition: Claiming complete reconstruction with a flat antenna or guessed capsule radius/placement.

assertions.review_instruction: Verify the antenna-to-capsule transform and curvature against Figure 9(b,c); require unresolved status for missing placement data.

source_issues.note: The exact transform from the planar layout to the curved capsule may not be fully dimensioned in the source.

evidence.excerpt_or_description: Table 3 supplies the final antenna dimensions; the reported footprint is 6 × 6 × 0.254 mm3.
The source identifies Rogers RT/Duroid 6010 LM with εr = 10.

expected.summary: Preserve reported dimensions and materials exactly and do not fill missing properties with assumptions.
expected.acceptable_alternative: Leave unreported conductor or capsule properties unresolved.
expected.forbidden_condition: Inventing a substrate, conductor, capsule dimension, or material property.

evidence.excerpt_or_description: The simulation setup discusses body propagation and the materials selected for electrodes, capsule components, battery, and modules.
The TCP capsule location inside the AustinMan heart-muscle model is an environmental setup, not antenna conductor geometry.

expected.summary: Keep capsule, electronics, tissue models, phantoms, and measurement fixtures distinct from antenna geometry while preserving their relationships.
expected.forbidden_condition: Treating heart tissue or measurement fixtures as part of the radiating antenna geometry.

assertions.review_instruction: Check role assignments for antenna blocks, capsule/electronics, biological environment, and measurement setup.

evidence.excerpt_or_description: The figures explicitly compare simulated and measured reflection coefficient and axial ratio.
Simulated and measured radiation patterns are shown separately for the integrated antenna in pork.

expected.summary: Keep simulated and measured results separate and preserve their test environment and design association.
expected.forbidden_condition: Collapsing simulation and measurement traces into one result.

verifiable_condition.target: antenna_results.json result origin, setup, and design reference
verifiable_condition.expected_text: simulated and measured results remain separate
